thread:
incident-bot Alert: high-429-rate detected on serving-prod (cluster: us-west-2). spike: 12x baseline in last 3m. page: #oncall-sre.

maria: seeing 429 + 503s across multiple frontends, started ~02:12 UTC. Grafana panel 'http.status.code by route' shows long tail from /v1/generate-long.

jonathan: confirmed, traces show heavy KV cache eviction on a few pods -> cascading slower tails.

maria: immediate plan: 1) apply per-tenant soft QPS cap (50%) 2) enable adaptive backpressure on long-completion route 3) disable experimental streaming for now. rolling these changes to a subset first.

leo: can we do surgical route disable? which flag?

maria: yes — feature flag: routes.streaming.experimental -> off for prod. patch: \n```\ncurl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://console/api/flags -d '{"flag":"routes.streaming.experimental","state":"off","scope":"prod"}'\n```

sre-oncall: I'll hold traffic shaping in the controller: set tenantBurst=0.5 and per-tenant qps cap to 120. doing canary to 3 pods now.

incident-bot: deploy job started (job-id: deploy-2101234567-3). ETA ~45s.

jonathan: moving heavy routes to slower-lane by setting routing policy 'safety-slow' for tenants with >95th percentile token usage. config snippet: \n```\nroutes:\n  /v1/generate-long:\n    default_policy: safety-slow\n    fallback_model: small-quantized-v2\n```

maria: support-ops can we draft a customer-facing blurb? we want to notify impacted tenants with high qps. list: tenant-43, tenant-87, tenant-2.

support-ops: on it, short notice: "We're currently mitigating increased error rates by temporarily capping request concurrency and redirecting long completions; some requests may be slower. We'll follow up with a post-incident summary." sending now.

leo: deploy finished on canary, telemetry looks cleaner, 429s down ~40% on canary slice. promoting to 25% traffic now.

incident-bot: autopager: pages escalated to oncall lead @maria (p1).

maria: good. rolling remainder in 5m windows. will annotate Grafana and mark runbook step 'apply-tenant-cap' executed.

jonathan: quick check: k8s events show high OOMKilled on model-pool-4 - unrelated but noise. keeping an eye.

sre-oncall: applied global per-tenant cap to 120qps across all pools; burst window 30s. verifying dashboards: 
- Grafana: http_errors/1m -> 429 rate trend down from 325rpm to 160rpm.
- Kibana: error-logs filter route:/v1/generate-long shows fewer KV eviction logs.

maria: switching metrics retention to 1s scrape inside mitigation for high-res charts.

support-ops: notified impacted customers (tenants 43,87,2). added link to status page and note on expected follow-up.

leo: enabling temporary cache pinning for medium requests to reduce upstream pressure. snippet: \n```\nPOST /internal/cache/pin\n{ "tenants": [43,87], "ttl": 120 }\n```

jonathan: I'm running a quick replay test against small-quantized-v2 to verify latency. responses look within SLO.

maria: 429 count now trending down to baseline-ish in us-west-2, but eu-west showing a small bump. routing policy was global — switch eu-west to local fallback only.

sre-oncall: switching eu-west routing to local-fallback. applying now.

incident-bot: routing-change recorded (cid: rc-2101234602).

maria: OK team — preparing handoff. next oncall @jonathan takes lead in 10m. notes for handoff: what we changed (flags, caps, routing), impacted tenants, support messages, runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/live-traffic-mitigation, and dashboards: Grafana panels ids: 23,24,42.

jonathan: ack. I'll keep the global cap in place until traffic pattern stabilizes for at least 30m and then slowly relax. will also schedule a follow-up to analyze model-serving KV eviction pattern.

support-ops: CS ticket created: #CS-9811 (tenants 43/87/2). added mitigation notes and ETA for post-incident.

leo: small postmortem note: consider adding explicit route-level circuit breakers for long-running completions to avoid this blast radius.

maria: agreed. please add to backlog under SRE/serving with priority P2. I'll file a short action item after handoff.

jonathan: taking over now — @incident-bot please update channel topic with "Mitigation active: tenant caps + streaming disabled — jonathan oncall" and set annotation on Grafana.

incident-bot: channel topic updated. annotation added to Grafana panel 23.

maria: handing off. leaving runbook link and checklist in thread. thanks team :thumbsup:

jonathan: thanks, leaving note: will monitor 429/503 for next 90m; escalate if >20% reversion or customer complaints increase.

incident-bot: thread closed by jonathan (handoff complete).
